title: Keep importer prose human authored and provide separate writing prompts

verify.note: Actual source action bodies run over inert author/tenant/provider dependencies. Malicious content is stripped; unauthorized and foreign intake calls deny before coaching; no save/apply dispatch occurs. Legacy model layout and reframe paths return null. Focused UI tests prove no content callback/autosave and recovery after failure. Local/mocked proof; exact-head CI and production acceptance separate. The actual extraction coercer rejects invented/uncited prose across tagline, About/Story, offerings, FAQs and Events and preserves exact source quotes; a permissive-source mutation exposes the former acceptance. Mock materializer writes and rendered review/manual Apply consequences are separately tested.

detail: Research retains source extraction, verification, commercial-fact gates, deterministic layout and explicit manual Apply. It no longer runs model reframe or model layout composition. Operator-edited prose survives renewed research independently of AI availability. Block and master-profile guidance returns questions only; the editor and review board show advice separately and never merge it into fields, save a model draft, refresh/reapply a page or persist mood as a consequence of coaching. Shared writing-coach preserves existing kill/budget/rate/accounting gates. Legacy pure layout/provenance helpers remain for compatibility with stored data; no migration, SDK change, provider mutation or connector claim. Depends on LIVE-1342 shared writing-coach helper. About and Story extraction additionally requires exact contiguous source text and a containing citation bound to the same supplied page URL or owner paste; fabricated, generated, inferred, foreign-cited, uncited and paraphrased values remain missing. The review renders missing text as Not set and explicit human Apply/manual editing remain available. The same quotation projector also gates tagline, offering blurbs, both FAQ question/answer and event title/blurb. FAQ and event prose share one containing source snippet and citation; unsupported FAQ rows or event titles are omitted. Factual date/price/name/category extraction, visual alt metadata and internal demographic analysis retain their existing roles. This does not claim every model call in the repository is retired.
